title: Galician Smoked Cheese Fritters
description: A crispy, cheesy snack inspired by the flavors of Galicia, Spain. Perfect for a quick appetizer or side dish.

ingredients.name: Galician cheese (Manchego)
ingredients.notes: Smoked or regular, whichever you prefer

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the Galician cheese, pisto, paprika, and zesty breadcrumbs.
2. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and add the water.
3. Add the egg mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until combined.
4. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small fritters.
5. Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
6. Add the fritters to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
7. Remove the fritters from the skillet and drain on paper towels.
9. Note: If you want to make these fritters more crispy, you can chill them in the fridge for 30 minutes before frying.
10. Be careful not to overcook the fritters, as they can become dry and crumbly.
